mamad_premium.source: Bank of Israel Research Department, Yachin & Talmon, March 2025, 'הפרמיה לממ"ד במחירי הדירות ובשכר הדירה'
mamad_premium.text_may_dec_2024_vs_jan_sep_2023: From May 2024 through end-2024 the mamad premium in asking rents was about 3.7–4.1 percentage points higher, on average, than in the first 9 months of 2023 (pre-war).
mamad_premium.garden_apartment: דירת גן appears only as a property-type dummy in the hedonic regression. No quantified garden-apartment rent premium is published in this paper. No other official quantified garden rent premium was found.
